summary: First full test pass on 'tare' Maintenance App. Verified the critical fix (supervisor router registration) and all new features via backend E2E script + live UI testing (Playwright) across Supervisor, Kitchen, and Admin/MaintSup roles. Backend E2E script (scripts/e2e_test.py) passed 29/29 steps confirming the full alert->assign->kitchen-prep->pickup->bin-replace->dirty-bin->cleaning pipeline. All requested UI features (Alert Detail page, Assign Staff modal, MCC slot navigation, Kitchen Fill Ticket + Email tooltip countdown, Operations Staff Tasks filters/inline actions, brand rename to 'tare', password placeholder fix, RoleNotAvailable page for admin, MaintSup Reports/Escalations/Notifications pages) were manually verified through the live UI and work correctly. Login lockout tested end-to-end with a disposable TEST_ user - locks exactly after 6th failed attempt with correct message.

minor.issue: allow_origins is set to '*' while allow_credentials=True. Per CORS spec browsers should reject credentialed requests when ACAO literal is '*' (not echoed origin). In practice this environment's proxy/browser did not block it during testing (login/cookie auth worked fine in Playwright), but this is technically a spec violation and could break in stricter browsers/environments. Recommend using explicit CORS_ORIGINS instead of '*' when allow_credentials=True.

issues: Uses native browser mm/dd/yyyy date input instead of a shadcn calendar component - minor/cosmetic since MaintSup module is out-of-scope per spec, but noting per design-review checklist.

action_items: Optional: tighten CORS allow_origins to explicit domains when allow_credentials=True (currently '*' + credentials, works in this environment but is a spec violation)
Optional cosmetic: replace native date inputs in MaintSup Reports with shadcn calendar component if that module is revisited (out of scope per spec priority)

Alert Detail page correctly shows all 17 fields + Recipes Affected + Suggested Action + 5 action buttons with correct data-testids.

Assign Operations Staff modal, Email Kitchen Staff disabled/tooltip countdown ('29m 57s remaining before this can be emailed'), and Machine Control Center slot->alert navigation via POST /api/alerts/ensure all work exactly as specified.

Operations Staff Tasks page filters (filter-machine/status/staff) and inline Bin Replacement row actions (reassign/priority/comment) all render and successfully call their respective endpoints with toast confirmations.
